purpose: Machine-readable register consulted by scripts/verify_archive_identity.py. Keep in sync with docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

rules.deviations: Files this repository changed on purpose. A diff limited to these is reported as a documented deviation, never as drift.
rules.generated: Files the UPSTREAM repository regenerates by itself (timestamps, run_id, manifests). Their blob may change within hours without anyone editing them, so a diff limited to these is reported as volatile, not drift.
rules.drifted: Anything not covered above. This is the only outcome that is a defect.
rules.generated_schema: For every generated file: required keys and JSON types that must hold. A generated file that drifts AND fails this check is drift, not volatility — a regenerated file is still supposed to be valid.
